summary.shortDescription: A dual-21700 regulated box mod, also compatible with 18650 cells, rated at 220 W.
summary.description: VAPORESSO documents the ARMOUR MAX as a dual-21700 regulated mod with 18650 adapter sleeves and 5–220 W output. An exact-device Vaping360 review measured 208 W, 8.979 V, and 39 A on its test sample, while the current manufacturer page retains the exact product documentation.
highlights: Exact identity and catalog relationship are established.
Manufacturer specifications and independent electrical testing are available.
The device is used as the canonical comparison entry for the GEN MAX candidate review.
